title: Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning enhanced Federated Learning for Predicting Remaining Useful Lifetime
abstract: arXiv:2611.31880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is central to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). The growth of industrial IoT has unlocked large multivariate sensor streams and enabled deep models - especially Transformers - for long-horizon sequence learning. However, transformers are parameter-heavy and data-hungry, while operational datasets are often siloed and privacy-sensitive. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this by training across clients without raw data sharing, but in practice many clients connect over lossy wireless links where UDP is preferred for low latency, making model exchange vulnerable to packet drops. We present a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that adapts FL to lossy channels by selecting per-client layer subsets to transmit and capping retransmissions. This framework is trained with QMIX value-function factorization for scalability. We instantiate the approach with a Graph Convolutio

translated_title: 基于多智能体强化学习增强的联邦学习用于剩余使用寿命预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31880v1 公告类型：新 摘要：剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测是故障预测与健康管理（PHM）的核心。工业物联网的发展解锁了大规模多变量传感器数据流，并使深度模型——尤其是Transformer——能够进行长时序序列学习。然而，Transformer参数量大且需要大量数据，而实际运营数据集往往各自孤立存储且涉及隐私敏感信息。联邦学习（FL）通过在不共享原始数据的情况下跨客户端训练来解决这一问题，但在实际中，许多客户端通过有损无线链路连接，出于低延迟的考虑倾向于使用UDP，这使得模型交换容易受到丢包的影响。我们提出了一种协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，通过自适应选择每个客户端需传输的模型层子集并限制重传次数，使联邦学习能够适应有损信道。该框架使用QMIX值函数分解进行训练以保证可扩展性。我们采用图卷积……来实例化该方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于QMIX值函数分解的协作式多智能体强化学习框架，通过自适应选择各客户端传输的模型层子集并限制重传次数，解决了有损无线信道下联邦学习在剩余使用寿命预测中因丢包导致模型交换脆弱的问题，同时兼顾了数据隐私保护。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework based on QMIX value-function factorization that adapts Federated Learning to lossy wireless channels by selectively transmitting per-client model layer subsets and capping retransmissions, enabling robust Remaining Useful Life prediction while preserving data privacy.
